latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of customer-onboarding-coach.

- Guides B2B SaaS/PLG teams in building or improving customer onboarding processes.
- Covers defining the activation event and measuring honest Time-to-Value (T2V).
- Provides coaching on designing onboarding flows for self-serve, mid-touch, and high-touch segments.
- Includes structural (product tours, sample data, integration accelerators) and operational (welcome calls, onboarding milestones, 30-60-90 day plans) onboarding strategies.
- Offers advice on instrumenting onboarding progress, detecting drop-off, and recovering stalled implementations.
- Supports best practices for handoff from onboarding to ongoing Customer Success Management (CSM).
